findings.summary: The regex in findDirectImports does not account for file extensions (like .js) in import paths, causing it to fail on all standard ES module imports.
findings.suggested_fix: Update importRegex to allow a file extension before the closing quote, e.g., by appending (?:\.[a-z]+)? after ${escapedTarget}.

findings.summary: The regex /-_/g in findDeterministicCallers attempts to match the literal string `-_` instead of a character class, failing to convert kebab-case filenames to camelCase.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the regex to /[-_]./g so it matches a hyphen or underscore followed by any character, correctly enabling (c) => c[1]!.toUpperCase() to capitalize the character.
